title: LedgerCore operation event v1

event_id.description: Equals journal_transaction_id; the stable operation UUID.

occurred_at.description: UTC journal creation time before the final source SQL commit.

amount_minor.description: Positive integral RUB kopecks; receiver additionally enforces <=9223372036854775807 without floating point.

description: Semantic receiver validation also requires canonical lowercase UUIDs, distinct account IDs, event_id equal to operation ID, and a valid reversal reference shape. Unknown optional fields remain additive-compatible. No tokens, idempotency keys or client metadata are emitted. See internal/events for executable validation.
